summary: This bill expands the surface transportation block grant program to fund the purchase and deployment of automated external defibrillators (AEDs) and the development of emergency action plans at transportation facilities, and directs the Secretary of Transportation to issue recommendations and guidelines for AED deployment and emergency plans at interstate transportation facilities.

scores.thoughts: The bill expands the surface transportation block grant program to include funding for AED deployment and emergency action plans, and directs the Secretary of Transportation to provide technical assistance. This would likely lead to increased federal spending through these programs.
